text: Puma SE, a Frankfurt Stock Exchange-listed European Company (SE) under German law, had its shareholder Artémis agree on 26 January 2026 to sell its entire 29.06% stake (43,014,760 shares) to ANTA Sports Products Limited (HKEX: 2020, listed since 2007) for EUR1,505,516,600 (~EUR1.5bn). This HKEX filing does not identify Artémis as the Pinault family's Groupe Artemis, nor state whether ANTA is Ding-family-controlled or privately vs. state-owned.

source.name: ANTA Sports Products Limited, HKEX announcement: Acquisition of 29.06% equity interest in PUMA SE
source.quote: the Company has conditionally agreed to purchase, and the Seller has conditionally agreed to sell, a total of 43,014,760 ordinary shares of the Target Company (representing approximately 29.06%
